label: Shape Intelligence — Normalization
goal: Build the deterministic, lossless normalization front door for every incoming information form.
purpose: Turn raw inputs into stable provenance-preserving source and segment records without semantic Shape judgment.
success_condition: Every admitted source produces reconstructable normalized records with stable IDs, offsets, structure, metadata, and deterministic safety handling.
objectives: Define the canonical normalized-source and segment contracts.
Preserve raw source and exact offsets.
Normalize objective structure and metadata only.
Emit safe, provenance-complete records for evidence assembly.
